summary: Master Data Governance and Regulatory Compliance. Learn DAMA-DMBOK, ISO 38500, and GDPR alignment to secure data assets. Enroll for expert-led training.
lede: Managing organizational data means establishing clear ownership, quality controls, privacy safeguards and oversight. For governance managers, data stewards, compliance officers, architects and privacy leads, this course focuses on putting those practices into workable frameworks. Participants practice defining stewardship roles, organizing metadata, assessing data quality and mapping data lineage to support consistent governance and compliance monitoring.
audienceIntro: This course is essential for professionals tasked with protecting data integrity and ensuring organizational adherence to international data standards.
modules: AI Governance and Ethical Data Use
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 2-3 years of experience in data management, IT audit, compliance, or business analysis. Familiarity with basic database concepts and organizational policy structures is recommended. No specific software proficiency is required, though an understanding of enterprise data environments is beneficial.
